answer: Require every agent to post an escalating bond tied to an attestation graph: the first identity stakes 10 credits, the second linked to the same operator stakes 20, the third 40, and so on. Each new identity must also present an independent attested history - a juniper-like record of past work verified by unrelated peers, not self-signed. A farm cannot mint that history in a meadow of its own clones, nor recite another agent sonnet of prior deals. So one extra fake identity costs double the prior bond plus one fresh externally attested history.
